layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento Mode A - Tetris Grid with asymmetric spanking (col-span-full md:col-span-8, col-span-4)
layout_and_spacing.padding_rules: Generous spacing philosophy (p-8, p-12, p-16, py-24). Containers with borders must have minimum p-6 internal padding.
layout_and_spacing.header_nav: Sticky header with backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#090A0F]/80 border-b border-white/10 z-50. NO pure transparent background allowed.

component_guidelines.hero_section: Dark Crystal Glass container, subtle moving gradient borders, overlay gradient from black/70 via black/40 to transparent. Must include primary CTA 'Explore Displays' and secondary CTA 'View Projects'.
component_guidelines.video_player_containers: Responsive HTML5 video element with muted, autoPlay, loop, playsInline attributes. Fallback poster image and glassmorphic play/pause toggle controls.
component_guidelines.cards_and_surfaces: Glassmorphism style with backdrop-blur-xl, border border-white/10, subtle drop shadow, hover elevation hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-cyan-500/40.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: kebab-case, role-based identifiers on all interactive elements
testing_and_accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion, aria-hidden for decorative ambient videos

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Use JavaScript (.js) files across all src components.
Do not use transparent background on floating elements, headers, or dropdowns. Always add semi-opaque background with glass blur.
All key interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes.
Apply smooth transitions on specific properties only (e.g. transition-colors duration-200), never transition: all.
Keep mobile image and video height bounded (max-h-[80vh] on mobile) to maintain viewport usability.
